definitions.explanation: Leaving one's current place of residence to move to a different area, especially in the context of official registration.
Being transferred from one workplace, school, or organization to another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}→転出届：09810_tenshutsutodoke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{転出|てんしゅつ}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: A moving-out procedure is required when relocating.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転出|てんしゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まら→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ず、⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}り→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In this area, the outflow of young people hasn't stopped, and the population keeps declining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大阪支社|おおさかししゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転出|てんしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was transferred to the Osaka branch.

examples.japanese: {転出先|てんしゅつさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I made friends at the school I transferred to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{転出|てんしゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まり→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧、⟦{引|ひ}き{継|つ}ぎ→引き継ぎ：08365_hikitsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われた→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: A sudden transfer was decided, and I was scrambling to hand over my duties.

notes:
{転|てん} (move, change) + {出|しゅつ} (exit, leave). The word emphasizes leaving or departing from a current location, as opposed to arriving at a new one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}→転出届：09810_tenshutsutodoke⟧ — moving-out notification (submitted to city hall)
- {転出先|てんしゅつさき} — destination of the move or transfer
- {転出|てんしゅつ}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ — moving-out procedures
- {転出|てんしゅつ}⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧ — moving-out certificate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}→転入：22235_tennyuu⟧ — moving in; transfer into — the opposite: arriving at a new location
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧ — change of residence — more general, focuses on the move itself rather than departure
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧ — job transfer — specifically a workplace reassignment to a different office
